help.title: Help for traders
help.intro: Questions wey people dey ask about group buying with SorobanPool.
help.noResults: No article match wetin you search. Try different words.
help.a0: Group buy na when traders join their orders together to reach wholesale price. You join open pool, pay the price wey dey now, and if more people join, price go drop. The difference go come back to you by itself.
help.a1: Your money dey for escrow on the Stellar blockchain. Supplier go collect pay only after organizer confirm delivery. If the group no full or supplier no deliver, you go collect full refund by itself.
help.a2: If price drop after you join, dem go refund the difference to you by itself when the pool settle. If the pool no full or supplier no deliver, dem go refund all your payment.
help.a3: If anything wrong with your goods, you fit report problem within 48 hours after delivery. Arbiter go check the evidence from both sides and go decide. If e correct, you go collect refund for the units wey dey affected.
help.a4: SorobanPool dey use USDC (dollar stablecoins) on Stellar for escrow and payments. This thing dey protect everybody from currency wahala during the pool lifetime. You fit pay for naira and the conversion go happen when you join.
help.q5: Wetin go happen if people no reach?
help.a5: If the pool no reach the minimum before deadline, everybody go collect full automatic refund. Nobody go lose anything.
help.q6: I fit add more units after I join?
help.a6: Yes. While the pool still dey open, you fit add more units. You go pay the price wey dey now for the extra units.
help.q7: How I go know when to collect my goods?
help.a7: When dem confirm delivery, you go see pickup card for the pool page with the address, window, and your units. You go confirm say you don collect by pressing 'I don collect' after you pick up the goods.
help.a8: Passkey na how your phone dey open: fingerprint, face, or PIN. E replace password and secret words, and e no dey ever comot your phone. Na your passkey dey protect your wallet, so na only you fit approve payments.
help.q9: Wetin if I lose my phone?
help.a9: If you dey use passkey wallet, sign in with the same passkey for your new phone. If you dey use device wallet (testnet only), you go need your backup secret to recover your money.
help.q10: I fit cancel after I join?
help.a10: No. Once you join, your commitment dey binding. If the pool no work or supplier no deliver, you go collect refund. If you receive damaged or wrong goods, you fit file dispute.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.section1Body: When you use SorobanPool, you agree to these Terms. If you no agree, you no fit use the service.
terms.section2Body: SorobanPool dey allow traders join group buying. Your money dey for escrow on Stellar blockchain and dem go release am only when the terms of each pool don meet. We no dey hold your money ourselves.
terms.section3Body: Na you go keep your wallet safe. You agree to give correct information and to use the service only for lawful things. You no suppose try to manipulate prices, collude with other people, or do fraud.
terms.section4Body: If pool no full or supplier no deliver, you go collect automatic refund. If you receive damaged or wrong goods, you fit file dispute within 48 hours. Arbiter go review the evidence and make decision.
terms.section5Body: SorobanPool dey provide the platform but we no dey guarantee the quality of goods, how suppliers go behave, or wetin go happen for any transaction. We no dey responsible for losses beyond the amounts wey dey for escrow for your transactions.
terms.section6Body: We fit suspend or stop your access if you break these terms or do anything wey go harm the platform or other users.
terms.section7Body: We fit update these terms from time to time. When we do am, we go notify you and ask you make you accept the new version before you fit continue to use the service.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Body: We dey collect your phone number for authentication, your name and market location for your profile, and transaction information when you join pools. We no dey collect more information pass wetin we need to provide the service.
privacy.section2Title: 2. How We Dey Use Your Information
privacy.section2Body: We dey use your information to run the platform, match you with pools for your area, process payments, and resolve disputes. We no dey sell your information to other people.
privacy.section3Body: Your wallet and private keys dey for your device, protected by your passkey. We no get access to your wallet or the ability to move your money. Transaction records dey for Stellar blockchain, wey everybody fit see.
privacy.section4Body: We dey share your display name and general location with other members of pools wey you join. If dispute happen, we go share relevant evidence with the arbiter wey dem assign. We no dey share your phone number with other users.
privacy.section5Body: You fit request copy of your data or ask us make we delete your account. Note say transactions wey dem record for blockchain, dem no fit delete am.
privacy.section6Body: We fit update this policy from time to time. When we do am, we go notify you and ask you make you review the changes.
